description: This file contains validation rules and utility functions for input validation in a software project, including functions for required fields, character length constraints, email and phone format validation, numeric validation, and special character checks.

methods.name: required
methods.description: Checks if the value is present based on type, returns true or error message.

methods.name: shouldNotExceedCharLength
methods.description: Returns a validator function that ensures a string does not exceed specified character length.

methods.name: validRange
methods.description: Returns a validator function that checks if a numeric string is within a given port range.

methods.name: digitsOnly
methods.description: Checks if the input string consists of digits only, allowing empty input.

methods.name: validEmailFormat
methods.description: Validates if the input string matches common email address formats.

methods.name: validPhoneNumberFormat
methods.description: Validates if the input string matches allowed phone number characters.

methods.name: shouldNotLessThanCharLength
methods.description: Returns a validator to ensure the string has at least the specified length.

methods.name: shouldNotContainSpecialChars
methods.description: Returns a validator that allows only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

ctags.name: digitsOnly
ctags.pattern: /^export const digitsOnly = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validEmailFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validEmailFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/
